//: Extends the root base, NOT ../../tsconfig.json. That file is the solution file:
`files: []` plus `references`. Extending a solution file means this project
does not inherit `skipLibCheck`, and without it `@cloudflare/workers-types`
ships a partial DOM lib that collides with TypeScript's own `lib.dom.d.ts`,
producing hundreds of errors inside TypeScript's own lib files.
`types` is set to only the Workers types, and deliberately NOT `node`: the
Worker runs in a workerd isolate with no Node globals, so a Node type here is
a type that compiles and then fails at runtime.
